title: EM-Audio: evidence-monotone audio representation reference implementation
description:
Reference implementation and reproducibility package for an evidence-monotone operator contract on derived audio representations: sample-exact interval provenance, declared kernel footprints, and a C2PA signed transport bridge, with a two-language differential oracle.

Every number in the accompanying manuscript is generated by executing the committed code; run_all.sh regenerates the tables, macros and figures from the machine-readable outputs. The package ships an independent third-party reproduction, including the two declared bounds that did not hold on that reproducer's machine.
